text: ok that is showing paint now but it is just filling it with paint and im using brush size 1
resolution: Fixed 'brush 1 fills the whole face'. The user correctly pointed out brush/fill are one mutually-exclusive group (a brush shows active only when fill is off) and brush 1 was active — so fill was NOT on; my earlier 'fill stuck on' theory was wrong. Real cause: Studio passed STUDIO.paintCellUnits=2 (about 12.5 cm) to every paint call, and the gun is proportional to a 1.65m player, so its faces are smaller than ONE cell — one cell equals the whole face, so brush 1 (exactly one cell) fills it. The meshPaint default of 0.5 was dead because Studio overrode it everywhere. Fix: cell size is now an adjustable paintCell state (default 0.25 model-units, about 1.5 cm, fine enough that a prop face spans several cells so brush 1 is a small dab), threaded through pick/brush/bake/overlay; PaintPanel gains a 'detail' row (fine/med/coarse/XL) to tune the paint resolution per model. Also made the tools cleanly exclusive: picking a brush size turns fill off, toggling fill turns erase off. Build clean; meshPaint 8/8. Needs rjit dev to confirm live: with the gun, brush 1 should now be a small dab (pick 'fine' detail if needed); 'fill' fills the whole face. NOTE: changing detail after painting reinterprets stored cells (paint shifts) — best set before painting a part. (req_1300 covered the same fix — the mutual-exclusivity edit is included, though the root cause was cell size, not fill mode.)
